capture: test runner and code coverage (CV1-CV5, CV8, I-C01..I-C04, I-C10, C-R1..C-R4, deployment gates)
captured: 2026-11-16 (UTC, 14:40-15:15)
orgs: fresh 1-day scratch orgs on campaign Dev Hubs, Developer edition, no features; each deleted and verified gone
sf: @salesforce/cli 2.157.8 (client 2.157.8), CLI default query API v68.0
class apis: 62.0 and 67.0 (class metadata apiVersion); deployment-gate scenarios at 67.0 only
captures:
  1  coverage and runner (CvShapeA/B, CvUnion, CvWeight, CvSetupCov*, IsoBase, SeeAllData classes, RunnerSurfaceProbeTest, setup failure)  62.0 and 67.0
  2  second shape set (CvShapeC), failed-test coverage (CvFail), async from setup and body, triggers  62.0 and 67.0
  3  deployment gates g1..g9, one org each, sf project deploy start --test-level  67.0
  4  setup-failure variants (custom throw, DML, null deref, limit)  62.0 and 67.0
columns: id, api, kind, subject, step, covered lines, uncovered lines, detail
  agg      ApexCodeCoverageAggregate row for subject (class or trigger), written when it changes; step is capture:tag
  per      ApexCodeCoverage row for TestClass.method; detail is the covered class; written when it changes
  org      ApexOrgWideCoverage.PercentCovered after the step
  run      sf apex run test --json summary; coverage runs add testRunCoverage, orgWide and per-class covered/total=percent
  test     method row from that run: method|Outcome|Message|StackTrace
  testResult ApexTestResult rows queried afterward: class|method|Outcome|setup|Message|StackTrace
  queueItem  ApexTestQueueItem Status|ExtendedStatus
  deployError  Metadata API component failure for a deploy rejected at compile
  deploy   sf project deploy start result: status, tests, failures, per-component covered/total, coverage warnings
  cliError sf apex run test command error
notes:
  Aggregate rows list a component only after deploy; an empty class, interface, or declaration-only class has a row with no lines.
  Per-test rows are replaced when the same test class runs again, so an earlier method's row can vanish. Aggregates only grow.
  In a run of several methods, per-test rows carry method-signature lines over from earlier methods. Solo runs do not. The conformance
  test uses solo rows only.
  The sf run summary adds uncalled triggers (0 covered) to every run's coverage list. Glade does not model that listing.
  Salesforce coverage varies in nothing observed between the two class API versions: every aggregate row matches at 62.0 and 67.0.
  Ids, usernames, hosts and aliases are scrubbed; async job and queue item ids are not kept.
